    BO13a §2.2.5: two long entries are never at distance two #

    • MulBasis.refl_contour: a long entry σ (s+2) of a minimal crown has a contour v with ρ (s+3) through the first arrow and ρ (s+2) through the last arrow of v (Lemma 5 a) and s225_perm).
    • MulBasis.b1: σ (s+2) and σ (s+3) are not both long (BO13a figures 9.2, 9.3: the D̃₅ tree F8R1A in P/τ, P/σ₁ or P/σ₂, or GR category 12 (F93) in P/σ₁). A gap in BO13a (the outs v₂, ρ₁'' at a) is closed by a second contour of σ₁ split at c' and Lemma 8.

    ∃ (b : RayCat.RayVert P) (c : RayCat.RayVert P) (α : RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.x (s + 3)) ⟶ b) (v' : Quiver.Path b (RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.z (s + 2)))) (u : Quiver.Path (RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.x (s + 3))) c) (ω : c ⟶ RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.z (s + 2))) (w : Quiver.Path (RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.x (s + 3))) (RayCat.RayVert.mk (C.toZChain.z (s + 2)))), α.toPath.comp v' = u.cons ω ∧ RayCat.pathVal (α.toPath.comp v') = C.toZChain.σ (s + 2) ∧ RayCat.pathVal w = C.toZChain.σ (s + 2) ∧ ¬RayCat.Interlaced (α.toPath.comp v') w ∧ (∃ (g : b.out ⟶ C.toZChain.z (s + 3)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑α) g = C.toZChain.ρ (s + 3)) ∧ ∃ (g : C.toZChain.x (s + 2) ⟶ c.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g ↑ω = C.toZChain.ρ (s + 2)
